title: China invades Taiwan by June 30, 2027
html:
Proposition

China invades Taiwan by June 30, 2027

China commences a military offensive intended to establish control over any portion of the territory administered by the Republic of China (Taiwan), including its inhabited islands but not uninhabited ones, by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET.

When
Any time to Jun 30, 2027
Known from
Official confirmation by China, Taiwan, the United Nations or a permanent member of the UN Security Council; consensus of credible reporting
Forecast2.5%
0%100%

How it’s set

Markets

  • Will China invade Taiwan by June 30, 2027?
    Midpoint 4.2%
    Polymarket · Open · Yes bid 4.1¢ · Ask 4.2¢ · Depth $204 · Price not used

Rationale

My figure for an invasion by mid-2027 is 2.5% against the market's 4.2%: the lower part of the range its price allows, weighted up from 1.5% because 2027 is the PLA's stated readiness year and Xi raised Taiwan directly with Trump this week. It moves in proportion with the market's odds.
